remarks: Completely renovated and upgraded-Private Balcony with City Views-Full-Service Building-Prime Stamford Location! Welcome to this bright and inviting condo at Fountain Terrace, ideally located in downtown Stamford. This well-maintained and COMPLETELY updated unit features a flexible open-concept living and dining area, highlighted by engineered wood floors, crown moldings throughout, custom doors, radiator covers & ample windows that fill the space with natural light. Step outside to your private balcony & enjoy sweeping skyline views-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The updated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, stone counters, & ample cabinetry-designed for everyday convenience. Two generously sized bedrooms offer comfortable space complemented by ample custom closet storage throughout, flanked by a renovated full bath! Residents enjoy a full suite of amenities, including elevator access, a swimming pool, fitness center, playground, 24-hour security, and on-site laundry facilities. The unit also includes a dedicated storage space in the basement+ 1 assigned parking spot & additional parking available. Ideally situated just minutes from Downtown Stamford, with easy access to restaurants, shopping, parks, medical facilities, and more. Approximately 1.5 miles to Metro-North and Amtrak for a seamless commute. HOA includes: heat, hot water, water, security, assigned parking, and access to all community amenities. Pet-friendly community
